metadata.title: Mid-Century Modern Pop Art Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s minimalist layout featuring a central grid of four stylized, heart-shaped faces in vibrant primary and secondary colors with clean sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: bold color block grid with thin ink lines
excludeWhen: ornate or serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a large central black rounded-corner square containing a 2x2 grid of four vibrant color blocks. Each block contains a soft-edged, heart-shaped face rendered in a contrasting bright color with minimalist black ink line features. The top section contains wide-tracked sans-serif text on an off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based symmetry within a central focal point
High contrast between thin black line art and saturated color fields
Hierarchy established by large top-aligned typography over a central graphic
Repetition of heart motifs with varied facial expressions
coreInvariants: Rounded-corner black container for the central art
Vibrant, non-blended color blocks (red, pink, yellow, orange)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central 2x2 grid occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame; typography occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black rounded square containing the four colorful faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold top text, moves down to the high-contrast grid, and scans the four faces clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white margins around the central graphic and between text lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background and black structural elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated Red, Magenta, and Yellow for the grid blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange and Pink for the internal heart shapes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the central grid contrasting against a neutral, low-value background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight but legible leading for main titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century Swiss-style authority and weight.
Provides the clean, neutral geometric look typical of the era.
Offers a slightly more vintage, sturdy feel for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an off-white paper texture background. In the center, place a large black rounded-corner square. Inside that square, create a 2x2 grid of four colored blocks (Red, Magenta, Yellow, Orange). In each block, paint a soft-edged heart shape in a contrasting color. Draw minimalist black ink line faces (eyes, nose, mouth) inside each heart.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a geometric sans-serif font like Akzidenz-Grotesk, typeset the main title in two centered lines at the top. Add metadata in smaller, wide-tracked text in the upper corners.

verificationChecks: Is the typography centered and sans-serif?
Are there four distinct faces in a 2x2 grid?
Is the background a warm off-white?
Are the facial features rendered as thin black lines?

adjustableVariables: Facial expressions of the line art
Tracking and weight of the typography
Corner radius of the central black frame
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or record label logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the black frame has consistent rounded corners.
Verify that the line art for the faces is thin and consistent.
Confirm the colors are saturated and do not bleed into the off-white background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans-Serif Typography + [2x2 Grid of Minimalist Illustrations] + [Off-White Textured Background] = Mid-Century Modern Graphic Style
